description: Schedule a project's deletion. Nothing is removed for 7 days: the project keeps running, its deploys are refused, and restore_project cancels the deletion; then its GitHub repo, K8s deployments and database are deleted. confirm_name states the project's name back exactly, as get_project answers it; any other value is refused and schedules nothing. One operation runs on a project at a time: while another runs, the call is refused and the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.

confirm_name.description: The project's name, stated back exactly

name: delete_project
title: Delete Project
